resources.string: Forwards every incoming call to the number below using your carrier\'s unconditional call-forwarding service. The redirect happens in the network, so calls are sent on before this phone rings.
Phone permissions are required to send the forwarding code.
Note: forwarding is provided by your mobile carrier and may incur charges or be unsupported on some networks (e.g. CDMA). Use only on a phone you are authorised to configure.
